questions.enonce_markdown: Many people think that modern technology does more harm than good to youths. Write an essay in which you examine both the positive and negative sides of modern technology, with concrete examples to support your point of view. *(200 to 250 words)*
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Un essai à deux volets s'ouvre par une introduction qui situe le sujet et annonce le plan, consacre un ensemble de paragraphes aux aspects positifs puis un ensemble aux aspects négatifs, chaque idée étant introduite par un connecteur et illustrée d'un exemple concret, et se termine par une conclusion nuancée qui ne répète pas l'introduction mot pour mot.

**Ce que le sujet impose.** Le sujet demande d'examiner les deux faces de la technologie moderne : un plan en deux volets équilibrés (positif, puis négatif), des exemples concrets dans chaque volet, et un avis personnel nuancé à la fin.

**Essai modèle.**

Modern technology has changed the way young people live, study and communicate. Many people believe that it does more harm than good to youths. In this essay, I will examine both its positive and negative sides.

On the one hand, technology offers many advantages. First, it makes learning easier: a student can watch an educational video or search the internet to understand a lesson that was unclear in class. Moreover, smartphones and social networks allow youths to keep in touch with relatives abroad at a low cost. Technology also creates job opportunities, for example in mobile money services, online marketing and computer repair.

On the other hand, it has serious disadvantages. Many teenagers spend hours on social networks or video games instead of doing their homework, which affects their results. Some are also exposed to violent or indecent content, or become victims of cyberbullying and online fraud. In addition, too much time in front of a screen reduces face-to-face contact with family and friends and may damage their health.

In conclusion, modern technology is neither entirely good nor entirely bad. It is a tool whose effects depend on how it is used. If parents and teachers guide youths towards responsible use, the benefits will largely outweigh the harm.

### Piège à éviter
Ne développe pas un seul côté : un essai qui ne traite que les dangers de la technologie ou que ses avantages ne répond pas à *both the positive and negative sides*.

### Conseil
Fais un plan en cinq lignes avant d'écrire : introduction, deux avantages avec exemple, deux inconvénients avec exemple, conclusion. Un essai improvisé perd en cohérence, et l'organisation est notée à part.
